neighbours.label: The piece ' co'/'co'/'Co' when it is the first piece of a word the tokenizer split (co|-ordination, co|agulation, Co|conuts, co|existence, (co|oking), not whole-token co- words such as company, cook, cost or code.
fire: The paper lists her as co-author alongside two colleagues from Leeds.
Small droplets slowly coalesce into larger ones as the emulsion ages.

The captain handed control to the co-pilot during the descent.
After weeks of pleading, she finally coaxed the cat out from under the porch.
Many couples now cohabit for several years before they marry.
We split the bills for internet, electricity and (cooking) gas each month.
Patients on blood thinners are tested for slow coagulation before surgery.

Small droplets slowly merge into larger ones as the emulsion ages.
